0.original: Matsya cannot help but fear the worst.

26.original: Search for the villagers of Palaka's Stand.

48.original: If Mehvan fled deeper into the jungle, she and her child are in grave danger! Wh-Whatever are we to do!? Gods have mercy!

50.original: You must try to stay calm, Matsya.

51.original: You cannot let fear consume you...

52.original: Do you want to turn into a beast like the others?

53.original: But...how can I at a time like this? They could be dead!

54.original: So...if I allow myself to be overcome by this fear, I, too, might become a beast? I am not sure I understand, but I will do my best...

55.original: Fear...consume me? What are you talking about?

56.original: Then...I, too, could become a beast? I...I understand. I think.

57.original: M-Me? A beast? What are you talking about!?

58.original: Gods... So that is what causes it? Then I have no choice...I must keep my fear in check.

59.original: I've seen to the wounded. How did the two of you fare? Did you find your friends?

60.original: ...I see. In that case, let us help you find the mother and child.

61.original: Before we leave, we must ensure the village will be safe in our absence.

62.original: Alisaie and I will patrol the area and search for more beasts.

63.original: Would you and Matsya speak with Elder Yeruvvet? Pray explain to him the situation, and join us as soon as you are able.

64.original: We <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> save Mehvan and her child. We can do that much for Qerasaf...

65.original: <sniff> It will not be easy... But I will tell the elder about Qerasaf...

66.original: I am heartened to see you both safe, but what of the family?

68.original: Say no more. I understand. We have lost another of our dear friends...

69.original: Qerasaf may be gone, but there is still hope for Mehvan and their child. Please find them, I beg of you!

70.original: And if, in your search, you come across anyone else who escaped the slaughter, pray tell them what has happened.

71.original: I will do my best to keep the villagers safe...and their spirits high.

72.original: Come, let us rejoin your friends at once!

73.original: Qerasaf and Mehvan married only three summers ago. The day their daughter was born...I had never seen them so happy. They did not deserve this─none of these people did.

74.original: We encountered no beasts during our patrol, thankfully.

75.original: Where might Mehvan have run off to? Think, Matsya, think!

76.original: I'm pleased to report that the vicinity appears to be beast-free─no doubt thanks to your earlier efforts.

77.original: And with that, let us resume our search for your friend and her child. Where should we begin, Matsya?

78.original: If we follow Ksiroda south, we will arrive at Purusa, a temple. It is a sacred place where people go to commune with the divinities.

79.original: It's possible that Mehvan sought shelter there, and perhaps other villagers as well...

80.original: Then it's settled. Matsya, stay close to me, all right?

81.original: You two, take the lead. Keep an eye out for beasts and anyone in need of help.

82.original: Very well. We make for Purusa, as quickly as we are able. With me!

83.original: Th-Thank you... I thought I was done for...

84.original: Hm? Mehvan? She is a friend of mine, too, but I have not seen her...

85.original: She must still be out there somewhere, trying to avoid the beasts. And with her child, gods... Worry not for me─I can make my way back to the village on my own!

86.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, wait! Purusa lies just up ahead, but something terrible has happened!

87.original: The beasts have come, and many have already been killed!

88.original: Alphinaud and Alisaie have gone to do what they can, but there are so, so many─more than I could count. You must be ready...

89.original: I...I am fine. I will be safe hiding here. Please, you must help those people!

90.original: Remain calm, and do not wander off! I will tend to the wounded.

91.original: Stay strong! We'll keep you safe─I promise!

96.original: The villager transforms into a beast and lunges towards you!

100.original: There you are! How fare the others?

101.original: ...I see. You've seen to all the beasts in sight? In that case, let's have everyone gather in front of the temple.
